craft_notes: Sthāyin: karaṇatva's split. Sanskrit-first: kartṛtāsparśi kept printed (held clean); śuddham pair kept. Rows: 1 ('that makes ten' closes — count end-weight). Close: 'that makes ten.' Rejected: 'agent-touch' singular — kept agent-touching (the -sparśi compound); resolving the printed form — held.

l4.sanskrit_cite: karaṇatvaṃ dvidhā śuddhaṃ kartṛtāsparśi ca iti daśa

reads_against.argmap: How does karaṇatva divide? → Karaṇatva splits śuddha-kartṛtāsparśi into ten.
c1_essence: Karaṇatva twofold — pure, agent-touching — makes ten.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of a scheme counted (wonder at arithmetic settling)
